TcExtension.description: The function to be used as the base action for the operation that returns a query function suitable to find variant data admissibility information in the context of a given object. The function returns an error if the business object type of the given object does not support variant data admissibility.
TcExtension.name: POM_object__getAdmissableVariability_method

TcOperation.description: Returns a query functor suitable to find variant data admissibility information in the context of this object. The operation returns an error if the business object type of this object does not support variant data admissibility.

TcAttribute.description: Defines the state of admissibility. The values are predefined in attached LOV Cfg0AdmissibilityState.
The object for which admissibility is defined. The actual object type will be validated in operation input descriptors for the specific instantiable subclass.

Indicates the level of protection of allocated objects with respect to the Cfg0ConfContext Item. Allowed Values are defined in LOV Cfg0ProtectionScope. This is analogous to the use of private and public class members in C++ and Java. This property value acts like access specifier of the allocation. For example in case of constraints of child module instances, access is limited to only public allocations. Initial Value is 0. Nulls are allowed to support legacy objects.

Selection Scope defines the boundary within a product hierarchy where the value set on a family is applied. Allowed values are:
Global - A family allocation is considered global when the value set on a family is propagated to all references of that family within the Product Hierarchy.
Local - A family allocation is considered local when the value set on a family is restricted to a specific Module and is not propagated to other references of the family within the Product Hierarchy.
Stores the Cfg0ConfContext Item to which the target object is allocated. NULL values are not allowed.
The thread of the target revision object (such as a Feature revision) that is associated with a context (such as a Cfg0ConfContext Item or a Cfg0AbsModel).
Specifies if the target object is available or not to the context object. If TRUE, the target family or Feature is considered as available.

TcClass.description: The Cfg0AbsAvailabilityRule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRule. It defines a configurator constraint rule to assert the availability of a Feature against a combination of Features in a product configuration.

TcAttribute.description: Stores the thread of a context object for which the availability is created. For example, it can be a Cfg0AbsModelThread.
Determines whether the combination in the table are valid or invalid
Stores the list of Feature threads collected by current compound value object. NULL value is allowed.

Stores reference to the Parent Configurator Context. A Configurator Module has a reference to the parent product. All Configuration Module revisions share the same parent product. The parent product cannot be changed after the object has been created.

Date used for configuring the Child Context. When configuring the child context, the Configuration Module will need to use a consistent rule date as a "Configured as On Date" so that changes in the child don't impact the result of applying module constraints that derive a child configuration. A new Configuration Module revision may specify a different rule date. If cfg0ConfiguredRevisionRule is NULLTAG then the child context will be configured with the same RevRule and rule_date as the parent context.
This property contains the reference to the child product. Different revision of Module instance can have a different child product.
This property references a list of child module constraints that derive a configuration of the child context from the parent context configuration.

Revision Rule used to configure the Child Configurator Context. If its value is NULLTAG then the child context shall be configured with the same RevRule and RuleDate as the parent context. This is useful for child contexts that represent Major Assemblies in a parent context.
List of Features presented from child context to parent context with respect to Module.

Specifies an array of key and value pairs as a collection of Cfg0ConfigCriteriaEntry objects. Each entry represents the Configurator Criteria parameter like Revision Rule, Effectivity, Rule Date, Severity etc. Modification of the individual criteria entry is not allowed. During update all the existing entries are swapped with new entries.
Stores a number that can be used to establish a sequence of configurator objects. Some configurator operations are sensitive to the order in which objects are processed. NULL value is not allowed.

Stores the list of object Intents. The default value will be NULL. Assigning intents to a Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO object does not change its behavior. Intents are used only to search, filter and sort Configurator Workspace Object. Allowed values are defined in LOV Cfg0ObjectIntentions. For example, the intent can be any combination of values Marketing, Sales and Technical.
Stores the message to display when this constraint rule is violated. NULL values are not allowed.
Stores the severity of violations of this constraint, for example Error, Information or Warning. Possible values are defined in LOV Cfg0ConstraintSeverity. NULL values are not allowed.

If FALSE, the object is considered to be a constraint rule. A constraint rule is the rule which can trigger reverse propagation. If TRUE, it cannot trigger reverse propagation. For Example: 'Set Default configuration' B=true if A=true. If input is B=false, then it would expanded to A=false if cfg0UseOnlyFwdPropagation is set to FALSE else it would not expand.

cfg0ExceptionFeatureThread is persistent typed referenced property which represents a feature thread from Dynamic Family members for which exception is defined as rule object. Exception Feature thread allows to query all features which has exception in a given product context. All revision of Exception Rule should have same exception feature thread. NULLTAG is allowed for cfg0ExceptionFeatureThread to begin with object creation.

cfg0ExternalOperations is an array of TypedReference Cfg0AbsExternalOperation which represents list of Product Configurator External Operation business objects.
cfg0ExternalOperations provides an ability to specify set of Product Configurator External Operation business objects. cfg0ExternalOperations are to used to execute each Product Configurator External Operation defined in list before or after the Product Configurator solve operation.
NULL value is allowed. If cfg0ExternalOperations is not specified, no custom Metamodel external operation is executed

When set to true, this property prints following information for external operation group execution of the Configurator Context: 1. The name of the block, the name of the Configurator Context 2. The execution stage of the external operation group, the start and end time of each external operation call 3. The number of external operations, the service endpoint, the operation name 4. The input family and output family with their values, the input criteria before execution, and the updated input criteria after execution.

cfg0ConfiguratorContext is TypedReference-Cfg0ConfContext which represents Product Configurator context to which External Operation Group is associated.
In Configurator Solve operations, the External Operation Group is executed belonging to given Configurator Context only.
NULL Value is not allowed

cfg0ExecutionStage is String LOV type which represents execution stage where External Operation Group is executed. The Execution Stages are Pre,Post
Pre specifies Execution Stage before the Configurator Solve Operations Post specifies Execution Stage after the Configurator Solve Operations
cfg0ExecutionStage provides an ability to specify value so as, at which stage to execute the External Operation Group i.e. before or after the Product Configurator Solve operations.
NULL Value is not allowed
This property is deprecated Teamcenter 12.2 onwards and will be removed in Teamcenter 14. Operation Id

This property is deprecated Teamcenter 12.2 onwards and will be removed in Teamcenter 14. cfg0OperationName is string type which represents the name of the custom Metamodel external operation defined in BMIDE.
The cfg0OperationName is used as name of the operation which will be used to invoke custom Metamodel external operation. cfg0OperationName adds value by providing an ability to invoke custom Metamodel external operation in Product Configurator
NULL value is not allowed

cfg0OperInputFamilyThreads is an array of Cfg0AbsFamilyThread which represents the set of Product Configurator Family thread.
cfg0OperInputFamilyThreads are required to be passed as input argument parameter while invoking custom Metamodel external operation defined in BMIDE. cfg0OperInputFamilyThreads adds value by providing Product Configurator Families in their custom Metamodel external operation for their any internal calculations. User has to make sure to pass required Product Configurator families to custom Metamodel external operation which is being requested to be invoked.
NULL value are allowed for cfg0OperInputFamilyThreads. If the custom Metamodel external operation does not require any Product Configurator Family, then NULL value are allowed. Again user has to make sure that custom Metamodel external operation requires any Product Configurator families or not.

cfg0OperOutputFamilyThreads is an array of Cfg0AbsFamilyThread which represents the set of Product Configurator Family thread.
cfg0OperOutputFamilyThreads are required to be passed as output argument parameter while invoking custom Metamodel external operation defined in BMIDE. cfg0OperOutputFamilyThreads adds value by providing Product Configurator Families in their custom Metamodel external operation so as to send the calculated value (if any) back to Product Configurator which can be used in Product Configurator families value for further Configurator solve operations. User has to make sure to pass required Product Configurator families to custom Metamodel external operation which is being requested to be invoked. NULL value are allowed for cfg0OperInputFamilyThreads. If the custom Metamodel external operation does not send any Product Configurator Family values back, then NULL value are allowed. Again user has to make sure that custom Metamodel external operation requires any Product Configurator families or not.

cfg0ServiceEndpoint is a string type which represents external calculations web service endpoint. It is used identify the calculations web service where calculations services are defined. NULL Value is allowed for this property

cfg0ServiceOperationName is a string type which represents name of external calculation's service operation name, The value of property is used as an additional path for REST service end location to call RESTful API NULL Value is allowed for this property.
Defines whether this family is discretionary by default. A value of TRUE means that valid product configurations exist which specify an empty value for this family.

Specifies whether feature is relevant in variant configuration or is a support feature to be used as an indirection to a constraint expression. This property when set to 'True' feature is not user selectable in Variant Configuration View.
Specifies whether or not the family is discretionary in a given context. It overrides the default value specified in property Cfg0AbsFamily.cfg0IsDiscretionary.
Stores list of family thread objects which are grouped by current group object. NULL value is allowed.

Stores a namespace in which the meaning of this family is uniquely defined. For families other than model family, NULL is a valid value. For a model family, value is locked to be equal to the fnd0VariantNamespace property of the owning Cfg0ConfContext Item.

This value identifies if the family does not hold pre-defined features. If set to TRUE, user does not define any concrete Feature for the family. Based on the cfg0ValueDataType, user can assign any feature to the family during expression authoring. For example, A Free-Form float family Length can have valid expressions like Length = 110.10, Length > 20.5, Length <= 200.67.
Specifies type of values which are allowed for the family. The types are defined in LOV Cfg0FamilyValueDataType. The sample values can be String, Integer, Boolean etc.

This value identifies that if user can make multiple choices for the variant options of the family. Say for a family Accessories with cfg0IsMultiselect set to TRUE, user can create valid expressions like Accessories = Cover & Accessories = Mats. If set to FALSE, the family becomes a single select family which means user can choose only single option for the family.
This value specifies a valid Unit of Measure for the family such as Kilogram, Meters, and Liters etc. The Unit of Measure must be created prior to specifying as a family attribute.

cfg0FeatureThreads is Persistent typed referenced array property which represents list of Feature threads grouped by current Dynamic Family object. Revisions of Feature Threads are mutually exclusive. NULLTAG is allowed for cfg0FeatureThreads to begin with object creation.

cfg0FeatureThreads is Persistent typed referenced array property which represents list of Feature threads grouped by current Feature Set object. The system will allow ORed boolean relation during grid authoring within configured revisions of these feature threads. NULLTAG is allowed for cfg0FeatureThreads to begin with object creation.

This property defines a group for sequenced include rules. When set, the Include Rule will follow a sequential order based on the sequence number property. This grouping is intended to simplify the management of related selected include rules by avoiding the need for unique sequence numbers for each. The system will ensure that the sequencing is respected for include rules within the same group.
Stores the model family thread to which current model is attached to. NULL value is not allowed.
Identifies the parent model thread in the Model hierarchy. If this property has null value then the current Model is not associated with any parent model.

Selection Scope defines the boundary within a product hierarchy where the value set on a family is applied. Allowed values are:
Global - A family allocation is considered global when the value set on a family is propagated to all references of that family within the Product Hierarchy.
Local - A family allocation is considered local when the value set on a family is restricted to a specific Module and is not propagated to other references of the family within the Product Hierarchy.
Stores the Cfg0ProductItem which owns the model family. NULL value is not allowed.
The list of Cfg0ConfContext Items to which the object is applicable.

This attribute is maintained internally and is not available for modification. This attribute is denormalized to hold references to Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd as this denormalization helps in improving performance of whereUsed operation.

If TRUE, the object is considered to be a Child Constraint. A Child Constraint is a Configurator Constraint which is used to derive the Child Configuration from the Parent. If FALSE, it is applicable to the Configurator Context objects to which it is associated.
Stores the Family thread to which feature object is attached to. NULL values are not allowed.

cfg0PackageFeatureThread is persistent typed referenced property which represents a Package Feature thread for which Package variant is defined as rule object. Package Feature thread allows to query all package features which has variation in a given product context. All revision of Package Rule should have same package feature thread. NULLTAG is not allowed for cfg0PackageFeatureThread.

TcClass.description: Generic Product Line used to represent series of Product Models. Product Line is less detailed, less precise compared to Product Models. Multiple Product model could be covered by single Product Line.

TcAttribute.description: Stores list of model relevant Feature threads which are used to define the current product line object. Here feature threads have to be member of some product models. NULL values are allowed.

TcClass.description: Generic Product Line Family thread. Multiple revisions of same Product Line Family will refer to single instance of this thread.
Generic Product Line Family used to hold the Product Lines.
Generic Product Line thread. Multiple revisions of same Product Line will refer to single instance of this thread.

TcAttribute.description: Stores the list of Feature threads which define current product model object. NULL values are allowed.

If TRUE, the object is considered to be a global rule. A global rule is the rule which is applicable to all the Cfg0ConfContext items. If FALSE, it is applicable to Cfg0ConfContext objects to which it is associated.
Specifies the format for authoring a rule. The types are defined in LOV cfg0RuleExpFormat.
This property is deprecated Teamcenter 10.1.3 onwards and will be removed in Teamcenter 11.1. Please do not use this property.
Stores the list of model threads which are summarized by current summary model object. NULL values are allowed.

This attribute holds reference of Cfg0AbsFamilyThread which represents the family for the current Cfg0AbsValueThread.This attribute will facilitate computation of cfg0Family property of Cfg0AbsValue. As of now this is an optional property and can be set as NULL.

Stores the type of solve that shall be performed when applying the variant criteria defined for this object for variant configuration. The integer value represents one or more solve type modifiers as documented in preference TC_Default_Solve_Type. NULL value is not allowed.

Stores a set of variant expression objects which are combined by OR operator. For example, a Cfg0ExcludeRule has two sets of model, applicability and payload conditions. Then, there will be two Cfg0VariantExpressionSet objects stored. NULL value is allowed.

TcClass.description: It defines a configurator constraint rule to assert the availability of a Feature against a combination of Features in a product configuration. The applicability of all availability rules for the same subject must be satisfied.

TcAttribute.description: The Product Context whose variability is compiled in this dataset.
The Adler32 checksum calculated on the Revision Rule Strings attribute. This serves as a convenient way of comparing two Revision Rule strings.
The timestamp of the revision rule which would serve us in knowing whether or not the Revision Rule has been modified in another session.
The Revision Rule against which the current dataset has been compiled for the Product Context.
This property captures the historic date for which the variability was compiled for the Product Context.
The Revision Rule recipe for this compiled dataset. This would include information like rule_date along with effectivity.

The Edit Context used for minor revision configuration during the creation of the Compiled Rule Set instance. This is non-modifiable property and can be specified only during the creation of the instance.
This property will provide the count of objects either allocated or owned including global rule by the product context for which the Compiled Rule Set is being compiled.

This property provides the depth of product hierarchy for which the Compiled Rule Set is being compiled for the Product Context. A product hierarchy depth of 0 indicates that the Compiled Rule Set dataset was compiled with the variability associated with the root product context only. If NULL, the dataset will not be considered for the product context, a new Compiled Rule Set dataset will be created with product hierarchy depth information.
This property will provide the count of combination tables attached to the constraint in the product context for which the Compiled Rule Set is being generated.

Selection Scope defines the boundary within a product hierarchy where the value set on a family is applied. Allowed values are:
Global - A family allocation is considered global when the value set on a family is propagated to all references of that family within the Product Hierarchy.
Local - A family allocation is considered local when the value set on a family is restricted to a specific Module and is not propagated to other references of the family within the Product Hierarchy.
Attribute representing the Configurator Criteria Value of type Date.
Attribute representing the Configurator Criteria Value of type Integer.
Attribute representing the Configurator Criteria Value of type Double.
Attribute representing the Configurator Criteria Value of type String.
Attribute representing the Configurator Criteria Value of type Boolean.
Attribute representing the Configurator Criteria Value of type Typed Reference.

Typed Reference attribute representing the Cfg0ConfigCriteriaKey of the product configuration parameter as an instance of Cfg0ConfigCriteriaKey. For example, the severity threshold of product configuration is stored as a key.

String attribute representing the name of the key. For example, severity threshold is a key which is stored for a product configuration. A key name is always unique. List of valid keys are maintained in CFG_CONFIGURATION_PROFILE' group of cfg_tokens.h.

Integer attribute representing the type of value stored against key. The value of this attribute must match a POM type token between POM_MIN_type_token and POM_MAX_type_token. The value type can be Date, Boolean, Integer, String, Double or UntypedReference.
Boolean attribute representing whether multiple values can be stored against the same key.

Typed reference property which holds the array of Configurator Context instance for the current constraint set. This is indication of current Constraint Set is owned by cfg0ProductItems. It is not-null property.

Specifies the availability bias of options towards product models. TRUE means variant options associated with this Cfg0ProductItem are available to all the associated product models unless explicit availability rules exist that make them unavailable. FALSE means variant options are unavailable to any associated product model unless explicit availability rules exist that make them available.

TcClass.description: Product Line used to represent series of Product Models. Product Line is less detailed, less precise compared to Product Models. Multiple Product model could be covered by single Product Line.
Product Line Family thread. Multiple revisions of same Product Line Family will refer to single instance of this thread.
Product Line Family used to hold the Product Lines.
Product Line thread. Multiple revisions of same Product Line will refer to single instance of this thread.

TcAttribute.description: Stores the operator for an expression literal in a value range. Possible values are PS_variant_operator_not_equal, PS_variant_operator_gt, PS_variant_operator_lt, PS_variant_operator_gt_eq, and PS_variant_operator_lt_eq (see <ps\ps_tokens.h>). NULL value is not allowed.
Stores the ID of the Feature object or the value to use for a free form family. NULL value is allowed.
Stores the Feature object this range expression compares to. NULL value is not allowed.

Specifies an array of key and value pairs as a collection of Cfg0CriteriaEntry objects. Each entry represents the Configurator parameter like Revision Rule, Effectivity, Rule Date, Severity etc. Modification of the individual criteria entry is not allowed. During update all the existing entries are swapped with new entries.

This property will hold information about Configurator Module hierarchies and their corresponding module-level expressions, specifically to support multi-level variant rules that span multiple configurator modules.

TcClass.description: Section represents ORed set of subexpressions

TcAttribute.description: Stores boolean condition in string format which is evaluated during solve. For Teamcenter Configurator, this will be in explicit Teamcenter format for example [familyNamespace]family = feature. NULL value is allowed.
Stores the normalized form of the configuration expression which facilitates the database level solve operation. NULL value is allowed.

Stores the state of the cfg0Formula. The valid values are 0 (constant FALSE), 1 (constant TRUE), -1 (validity function), -2 (countermand function), and NULL (never saved successfully). NULL value is allowed.

Stores name of the product which anchors the variability consumed in the expression. Used in conjunction with cfg0ProductNamespace parameter to resolve any ambiguity in variant variable names. For example, resolving Capacity into [Refrigerator]Capacity versus [WashingMachine]Capacity. NULL value is allowed.

Stores namespace of the product which anchors the variability consumed in the expression. Used in conjunction with cfg0ProductName parameter to resolve any ambiguity in variant variable names. For example, resolving Capacity into [Refrigerator]Capacity versus [WashingMachine]Capacity. NULL value is allowed.

Stores the sub-expressions which are combined by OR operator. For example, a rule has multiple or split model conditions as Models = LXI OR Models = ZXI. There will two sub-expressions stored in the property. NULL value is allowed.
Stores the operator representing the type of the expression. PS_variant_operator_load_if is an example of a C style macro defined in ps/ps_token.h.

Stores name of the logical grouping of Features in a variant expression. NULL value is not allowed. For example, if the condition is Color = Red OR Color = Blue, then, the logical grouping of terms is family name Color. Then the cfg0Name would have value as Color. NULL value is not allowed.

Stores a list of expression terms in this group. A mixture of positive and negative expression terms in the same expression group is not allowed. Positive terms are combined with operator OR. Negated terms are combined with operator AND. NULL value is not allowed.

The terms with in a group are OR connected. Under normal scenario, all terms in a group is restricted to single family. However if user wish to create ORed expression referring to more than one family then user needs to create a concert instance of cfg0AbsFeatureSet/cfg0AbsFeatureFamily or its subtype. Refer this instance of feature set as a context for group expression.

TcClass.description: Set represents ANDed set or Variant Sections.

TcAttribute.description: Stores the variant expression sections which are combined by AND operator. For example, a Cfg0ExcludeRule has a set of model, applicability and payload conditions. Then, there will be three Cfg0VariantExpSection objects stored corresponding which are interpreted as an AND combination of model & applicability & payload. NULL value is not allowed.
Stores the operator for this expression term. Possible values are PS_variant_operator_is_equal and PS_variant_operator_not_equal (see <ps/ps_tokens.h>). NULL value is not allowed.

Stores a list of elemental expression literals describing a feature range for a given Family. If this VLA is not empty, then a family object must be present but feature name and feature object must be empty. NULL value is not allowed.

Stores the ID of the Feature object or the feature to use for a free form family. If this attribute is not empty, then the family object must be present but attribute cfg0ValueObject must be empty. NULL value is not allowed.

Stores the thread of the family object. If a family object thread is specified, then either a feature name or feature range expressions must be specified, but no feature object can be specified. NULL value is not allowed.
Stores the thread of the feature object. If a feature object thread is specified, then feature name, range expressions and family object must not be specified. NULL value is not allowed.

It is a string attribute which represents how a Cfg0VariantExpressionTerm is selected. Null value is allowed. When user saves a variant expression, the individual term could be selected as (refer Cfg0SelectionClassification LOV): EmptyInitialized Default PackageDefault Unknown Info Warning Error User

cfg0LongValueText is persistent property of type POM_long_string which represents the ID of the Feature object or the feature to use for a free form family. This attribute should be used only if ID of feature is greater than 128 character else use property cfg0ValueText. If this attribute is not empty, then the family object must be present but attribute cfg0ValueObject must be empty. NULL value is allowed.

Stores the groups in a variant expression which are combined by an AND operator. For example, if an applicability condition of a rule has an expression Color=Red & Size = Large, then, there will be two Cfg0VariantExpressionGroup objects stored in the Cfg0VariantSubExpression. NULL value is not allowed.

OperationInputProperty.description:
cfg0OperationInputFamilies is an array of Cfg0AbsFamily which represents the set of Product Configurator Family
cfg0OperationInputFamilies are required to be passed as input argument parameter while invoking custom Metamodel external operation defined in BMIDE. cfg0OperationInputFamilies adds value by providing Product Configurator Families in their custom Metamodel external operation for their any internal calculations. User has to make sure to pass required Product Configurator families to custom Metamodel external operation which is being requested to be invoked.
NULL value are allowed for cfg0OperationInputFamilies. If the custom Metamodel external operation does not require any Product Configurator Family, then NULL value are allowed. Again user has to make sure that custom Metamodel external operation requires any Product Configurator families or not.

cfg0OperationOutputFamilies is an array of Cfg0AbsFamily which represents the set of Product Configurator Family.
cfg0OperationOutputFamilies are required to be passed as output argument parameter while invoking custom Metamodel external operation defined in BMIDE. cfg0OperationOutputFamilies adds value by providing Product Configurator Families in their custom Metamodel external operation so as to send the calculated value (if any) back to Product Configurator which can be used in Product Configurator families value for further Configurator solve operations. User has to make sure to pass required Product Configurator families to custom Metamodel external operation which is being requested to be invoked. NULL value are allowed for cfg0OperationInputs. If the custom Metamodel external operation does not send any Product Configurator Family values back, then NULL value are allowed. Again user has to make sure that custom Metamodel external operation requires any Product Configurator families or not.

cfg0ServiceEndpoint is a string type which represents external calculations web service endpoint. It is used identify the calculations web service where calculations services are defined. NULL Value is allowed for this property

cfg0ServiceOperationName is a string type which represents name of external calculation's service operation name, The value of property is used as an additional path for REST service end location to call RESTful API NULL Value is allowed for this property.

TcDataset.description: A Dataset encapsulating the pre-compiled rule set in an XML named reference. The XML file stores the configured rule set of the Product Context (cfg0ProductContext) for the Revision rule (cfg0RevRule) for the rule date (cfg0ConfiguredAsOfDate)

The Cfg0TableDataset is a subtype of Dataset designed to store large sets of feature combinations referenced by the Combination Table Rule. It serves as the source for valid or invalid configuration combinations, supporting scalability for datasets that may exceed 20,000 entries.

TcRuntimeType.description: Cfg0ConfiguratorPerspective is a runtime business object that represents the configuration information required for the Product Configurator in Teamcenter.Cfg0ConfiguratorPerspective handles the revision configuration behavior of the allocated configurator objects. It uses the revision rule, the configurator context list; the compiled rule set date etc. to determine the allocated and configured to be provided.The cfg0ProductItems property is used to capture the configurator contexts. cfg0RevisionRule property is used to capture the revision rule. cfg0RuleSetCompileDate property is used to capture the date and time of the compiled rule set to be configured.Cfg0ConfiguratorPerspective object is used as communication mechanism for the configuration and the valid configurator contexts across the Product Configurator and its consuming applications such as 4G Designer, Structure Manager.

TcProperty.description: It is a reference property which holds the Revision Rule instance for the current perspective.The variability information (such as properties cfg0IncludeRules, cfg0OptionValues, etc.) provided by the perspective are configured using the Revision Rule specified in this property and the property cfg0RuleSetCompileDate. When the perspective is instantiated the default revision specified by the preference 'Cfg0DefaultRevisionRule' is populated. The user can change the property as required. The property cannot be set to empty or null reference.The cfg0RevisionRule property is referred by all the configurator APIs that accepts the perceptive as configuration information.NULL values are not allowed for the cfg0RevisionRule.

This property is deprecated Teamcenter 11.5 onwards and will be removed in Teamcenter 13. Please do not use this property. It is a reference property which holds the Variant Criteria instance for the current perspective.When the perspective is instantiated no value is set as the default. The user can change the property as required. The property can be set to empty or null reference.The cfg0VariantCriteria property is used to provide the criteria for solve operations that accepts the perspective as configuration information.NULL values are allowed for the cfg0VariantCriteria.

It is a reference property which lists the inclusion rules for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the inclusion rules allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The inclusion rules are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the exclusion rules for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the exclusion rules allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The exclusion rules are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Features for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the Features allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Features are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the family groups for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the family groups allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The family groups are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the product models for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the product models of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The product models are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which holds the list of the configurator context instances for the current perspective.The variability information (such as properties cfg0IncludeRules, cfg0OptionValues, etc.) provided by the perspective is based on the allocations to the configurator contexts set in the property cfg0ProductItems. The property is populated with the configurator context using which the perspective instance is created. The user can change the property as required. The property cannot be set to empty or null reference.The cfg0ProductItems property is referred by all the configurator APIs that accepts the perceptive as configuration information.NULL values are not allowed for the cfg0ProductItems.

It is a reference property which lists the variant criteria for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the variant criteria associated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the model families for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the model families of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The model families are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Families for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the Families allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Families are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the default rules for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the default rules allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The default rules are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.
Property to carry the edit context information. Client can set change proposal or change space.

It is a date property which holds the date & time of the compiled rule set used for the current perspective.The variability information (such as properties cfg0IncludeRules, cfg0OptionValues etc.) provided by the perspective are configured using the Revision Rule specified in this property and the property cfg0RuleSetCompileDate. The user can change the property as required. The cfg0RevisionRule property is referred by all the configurator APIs that accepts the perceptive as configuration information.NULL values are allowed for the cfg0RuleSetCompileDate.

It is a property which holds the list of intent values for the perspective.When the perspective is instantiated no value is set as the default. The user can change the property as required. The property can be set to empty or list of intent string values.The cfg0Intents property is used to provide the criteria for privileged operations that accept the perspective as configuration information.
Specifies the effectivity criteria used in the configuration perspective instance.

cfg0AvailabilityRules is a reference property which represents the availability rules for the configurator contexts of the perspective. cfg0AvailabilityRules provides the list of the availability rules allocated to configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the exception rules for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the exception rules allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The exception rules are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the package rules for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the package rules allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The package rules are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Effectivity Families for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the Effectivity Families allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Families are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Effectivity Intents for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the Effectivity Intents allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Effectivity Intents are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Features for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the Features allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Feature Sets for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the Feature Sets allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Feature Sets are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Dynamic Families for the configurator contexts of the perspective.This property provides the list of the Dynamic Families allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the module instances for the configurator contexts of the perspective. This property provides the list of the Module s present in a a configurator context. The module instances are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule.

It is a reference property which lists the private Families for the configurator contexts of the perspective. This property provides the list of the private Families allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Families are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule.

It is a reference property which lists the public Families for the configurator contexts of the perspective. This property provides the list of the public Families allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Families are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule.

It is a reference property which lists the private Features for the configurator contexts of the perspective. This property provides the list of private Features allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Features are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule.

It is a reference property which lists the public Features for the configurator contexts of the perspective. This property provides the list of public Features allocated to the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The Features are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule.

This property provides the depth of product hierarchy for a given Configurator Perspective. A product hierarchy depth of 1 indicates that the perspective is instantiated with the variability associated with the root product context only. Valid values are 1,2 and 3. The property cannot be set to empty or null.
It is a reference property which lists the Product Line Families of the configurator context specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.
It is a reference property which lists the Summary Model Families of the configurator context specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Package Option Families of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The package option families are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Summary Option Families of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The package option families are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Product Lines of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems in the perspective. The product lines are configured by the Revision Rule specified in the property cfg0Revision Rule. This is a read-only property.
It is a reference property which lists the Summary Models of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Matrix Constraints for the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which list of the Arithmetic Constraints allocated to configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.
It is a reference property which lists the Freeform Constraints for the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.

It is a reference property which lists the Variant Criteria associated with the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.
It is a reference property which lists the Summary Option Values of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.
It is a reference property which lists the Package Option Values of the configurator contexts specified in the property cfg0ProductItems of Configurator Perspective. This is a read-only property.

TcRuntimeType.description: A search cursor object tracks the search results from a configurator object search.

TcProperty.description: Chunk size of found objects to be returned in next fetch
Index of the first object to be returned in the next fetch

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsAdmissibility is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsAssociation. It defines association of a product configuration object such as Family with a context object.Users cannot instantiate the Cfg0AbsAdmissibility class. However, user can create a concrete subtype of Cfg0AbsAdmissibility to associate a Family or value with a context such as Ptn0Partition. The Cfg0AbsAdmissibility object has predefined states such as available to the context or not available to the context. The states are defined in LOV Cfg0AdmissibilityState.

The Cfg0AbsAdmissibilityThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsAssociationThread. It holds attributes common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsAdmissibility. The context object of a Cfg0AbsAdmissibility is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsAdmissibility object. It cannot be changed once the object is saved.

The Cfg0AbsAllocation is the abstract subtype Cfg0AbsAssociation. It associates product configuration data such as Family or feature to a Cfg0ConfContext Item.The Cfg0AbsAllocation helps user to reuse the same product configurator Family or feature across multiple products. For example, a variant option Coolant can be used in a Refrigerator product as well as in an Air Conditioner product. Hence, user can create the Coolant option and an allocation of the family with a Cfg0Dictionary. The Coolant option acts as the target object of the allocation. User can then create allocations of the same Coolant option with the Refrigerator and Air Conditioner products. In user interface, for a given Cfg0ConfContext Item, a product configurator option object can get configured only when its Cfg0AbsAllocation object is configured.

The Cfg0AbsAllocationThread is abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsAssociationThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsAllocation object.The Cfg0ConfContext Item for which the allocation is created is common to all revisions of Cfg0AbsAllocation. It cannot be changed once the object is saved.
The Cfg0AbsArithmeticConstThrd is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsArithmeticConstraint object.

The Cfg0AbsArithmeticConstraint is abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRule. It defines a Configurator Constraint to support multiple incremental mathematical operations like += and -= for a free-form family as part of Solve process. Example: User want to add a solve behavior where if RoofCarrier is selected then FrontWeight is incremented by 10 Unit and RearWeight is incremented by 5 unit. where if Spoiler is selected then RearWeight is incremented by 6 unit. This can be achieved by authoring an Arithmetic Constraint with Condition as RoofCarrier and Subject as FrontWeight=10 & RearWeight=5 and so on. Subject expression for these type of constraint must be free-form numeric family only. Incase of Arithmetic Constraint if the operation type is +=, then value for Family in subject is incremented with value in subject expression. Similarly, if the operation type for ArithmeticConstraint is -=, then value for Family in subject is decremented with value in subject expression. The product configuration is evaluated against all such configurator constraints applicable to the product to determine if it is a valid or invalid configuration and expand the configuration parameter like free-form Family if necessary to make it a valid.

The Cfg0AbsAssociation is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO. It associates any product configurator workspace object such as Family or feature to an anchor object like Cfg0ConfContext Item.The Cfg0AbsAssociation allows user to specify the target object for the association.

TcProperty.description: Specifies revision of a Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO object which is associated with a Cfg0ConfContext or Cfg0AbsModel.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsAssociationThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd. It represents a thread object which is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsAssociation object.The target object of a Cfg0AbsAssociation is common to all its revisions. It cannot be changed once the object is saved.

The Cfg0AbsAvailability is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsAssociation. It associates any product configurator workspace object such as families and values with a context object such as Cfg0AbsModel.The Cfg0AbsAvailability allows making a family or feature available or un-available to say a Cfg0AbsModel. For example, in Car product with models LXI and ZXI, there could be an option 'Rear Wiper' available to only ZXI. This constraint can be materialized using the instance of a concrete subtype of Cfg0AbsAvailability. The target of the Cfg0AbsAvailability will be the Feature 'Rear Wiper' and the context will be the model ZXI. The availability objects behave as constraints during validation of the product configurations.

TcProperty.description: Specifies a context object revision such as Cfg0AbsModel to which a family or a feature is made available.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsAvailabilityRule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRule. It defines a configurator constraint rule to assert the availability of a Feature against a combination of Features in a product configuration.
The Cfg0AbsAvailabilityRuleThrd is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsAvailabilityRule object.

The Cfg0AbsAvailabilityThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsAssociationThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsAvailability object.The context object for which the availability is created is common to all revisions of Cfg0AbsAvailability. It cannot be changed once the object is saved.

The Cfg0AbsCombinationTable is an abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRule. It defines a rule type that manages large sets of feature combinations in a product configuration. This object enables users to specify whether listed combinations represent valid or invalid configurations, providing explicit behavior for constraint evaluation. The rule references a dataset attachment containing these combinations, ensuring scalability, data integrity, and clear validity semantics within complex product configurations.

TcProperty.description: Cfg0CombinationRelation is a subtype of IMAN_relation. This business object is created to maintain the relation between Cfg0CombinationTable and Cfg0TableDataset business objects. This relation is used for Combination table constraint in configurator context.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsCombinationTableThrd is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsCombinationTable object.
The Cfg0AbsCompoundFamilyThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionFamilyThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsCompoundValueFamily object.

The Cfg0AbsCompoundOptionValue is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionValue. It represents compound variant configuration options such as summary and package.The Cfg0AbsCompoundOptionValue helps user to represent the summary or Feature Packages and assign member Features to them. For example, for the product Car, user can create a Navigation package of Features like GPS Receiver, Electronic Compass and LCD Display. User can create a Navigation Feature Package as an instance of concrete subtype of Cfg0AbsCompoundOptionValue and assign GPS Receiver, Electronic Compass and LCD Display as packaged members. The compound Features function as additional constraints for validating the product configurations.

TcProperty.description: Specifies the list of feature revisions collected by current compound feature object.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsCompoundValueFamily is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionFamily. It facilitates creation of compound variant configuration Features.The Cfg0AbsCompoundValueFamily anchors the compound variant configuration Features such as summary or package values.
The Cfg0AbsCompoundValueThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionValueThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsCompoundOptionValue object.
The Cfg0AbsConfiguratorCritThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsConfiguratorCriteria object.
The Cfg0AbsConfigModuleThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd. It represents a thread type which is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsConfigurationModule object.

The Cfg0AbsConfigurationModule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO. Generic Configurator Module represents a link between a parent configurator context with its child context. Here the parent configurator context remains constant whereas Child context can change for each revision. Using Configuration Module objects, a hierarchy of products can be linked that can evolve independently.

TcProperty.description: This runtime property returns the configurator perspective object of the child module.

TcStandardType.description: This is deprecated and not used in version 11.5 and above. The Cfg0AbsConfiguratorCriteria stores the product configuration information like Variant Expression, Revision Rule, Effectivity, RuleDate, Order/Overlay Mode, IsValid, IsComplete etc. This configuration information is stored as collection of Key/Value Pairs. User creates a Configurator Criteria to persist a product configuration created in Product Configurator Application to retrieve and apply to product content.

The Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO is the abstract subtype of WorkspaceObject. It serves as base class of all user level product configuration objects which user can handle in Product Configurator.The Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO helps user to specify an object id to identify the object during product variant configuration. User can also set intents on Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO such as Marketing, Manufacturing or Technical. Attributes are added to also support the sequencing of objects and adding effectivity information.

TcProperty.description: Specifies the effectivity expression set on the object like [Teamcenter::]Date >= 2015-06-01T05:30:00Z. User can use this property to set as well as get the effectivity for the object. The configuration of object in User interface will depend on the effectivity set on the object and the one on the Revision Rule set on the User Interface.
This relation indicates that there is a neutral format dataset (e.g. JPEG dataset with a JPEG file) attached that can be rendered by the viewer.

This property provides the allocation object for variability objects such as Cfg0AbsFamily, Cfg0AbsFamilyGroup, Cfg0AbsValue and its subtypes. For all other subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO this property will be null.
This property defines the variant criteria for configuring a Workspace Object. For example, to select an Electric Engine, set the property value as "EngineType=Electric".

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd is the abstract subtype of Fnd0WSOThread. It represents a thread type which is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO object.

The Cfg0AbsConstraintRule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsRule. It defines a configurator constraint rule for product configurations.The Cfg0AbsConstraintRule helps user to express a restriction to a combination of Features in a product configuration. User can specify a message which is returned if the restriction is violated in a product configuration. User can also specify the severity such as Error, Information or Warning for the rule. In user interface, the rules and the violations can be viewed based on selected severity.
The Cfg0AbsConstraintRuleThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsConstraintRule object.
Generic Default Rule
The Cfg0AbsDefaultRuleThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsDefaultRule object.

The Cfg0AbsEffFamilyThread is the abstract extensible subtype of Cfg0AbsFamilyThread. The Cfg0AbsEffFamilyThread has many attributes which are independent of its revisions. It cannot be changed once the object is saved.

The Cfg0AbsEffIntentThread is the abstract extensible subtype of Cfg0AbsValueThread. Cfg0AbsEffIntentThread has many attributes which are independent of its revisions. It cannot be changed once the object is saved.

The Cfg0AbsEffectivityFamily is the abstract extensible subtype of Cfg0AbsFamily. It represents the Effectivity Family to user. The Cfg0AbsEffectivityFamily helps user to anchor the Effectivity Intents. For example, to provide different Intent options for his product say Approved, Carryover and Working, user can create a effectivity family EngineIntent and associate it with the Cfg0ConfContext Item such as Cfg0ProductItem or Cfg0Dictionary. Then, user can define the above Intents linked to the effectivity family. User can create the Cfg0AbsEffectivityFamily with only String data type along with extra qualification such as free-form values, multi-select values, Unit Of Measure. A Generic Effectivity Family is uniquely identified with its attributes cfg0ObjectId and cfg0FamilyNamespace.

The Cfg0AbsEffectivityIntent is the abstract extensible subtype of Cfg0AbsValue. It represents the Intent Effectivity options to user. For example, to provide Intents for Effectivity Family EngineIntent such as Approved, Carryover and Working, user can create a string family say EngineIntent and associates it with the Cfg0ConfContext Item.

The Cfg0AbsExceptionRule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRule. The Cfg0AbsExceptionRule helps user to group the variant configuration Features which are mutually exclusive with an exception conditions in the form of variant and effectivity conditions. For example Red, Black, White, Taxi, PoliceCar are grouped in a single Dynamic Family to achieve mutually exclusive behavior among them. These are different possible Colors of Product Variant. However Taxi feature has exception to a specific product model, here user can define exception rule for it. Applicability of a exception rule is Dynamic Family with which member(s) feature is defined for mutually exclusive. Subject is product model or a variant condition of exception. User should associate exception rules to the Cfg0ProductItem to take participation during variant configuration.

TcProperty.description: cfg0ExceptionFeature is runtime typed referenced property which represents a revision of Feature from Dynamic Family members for which exception is defined as rule object. Exception Feature allows to query all features which has exception in a given product context. cfg0ExceptionFeature provides a configured revisions of value referred by cfg0ExceptionFeatureThread for current Exception Rule object per Configurator Perspective.

TcStandardType.description: Generic Exception Rule Thread

The Cfg0AbsExcludeRule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRule. It defines a configurator constraint that defines an option incompatibility rule in a product configuration.The Cfg0AbsExcludeRule helps user to express a restriction to a combination of Features in a product configuration. For example, user can create a rule specifying incompatibility of Transmission as Auto, whenever Car model is Economy and the Fuel Type is Petrol. For given conditions, if the Transmission is selected as Auto, then, it would be an invalid product configuration. The product configuration is evaluated against all such configurator constraints applicable to the product to determine if it is a valid or invalid configuration. In case of an invalid product configuration, a violation with the message and severity of the violated rule is returned to user.
The Cfg0AbsExcludeRuleThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsExcludeRule object.

Cfg0AbsExternalOperBlock is the generic business object which represents Product Configurator external operation group. It stores list of external operations, configurator context and execution stage. It can be used to call the external operations either in Pre or Post processing for given configurator context

The Cfg0AbsExternalOperBlockThd is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd. It stores the Configurator Context and the Execution Stage which are referred in Cfg0AbsExtOperationsBlock. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsExternalOperBlock object

The Cfg0AbsExternalOperThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsModelScopedWSOThrd. It stores the External operation name which is referred in Cfg0AbsExternalOperation. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsExternalOperation object

Cfg0AbsExternalOperation is the generic business object which represents Product Configurator external operation. It stores the operation name, input parameters and output parameters. It can be used to call the external operation which is defined in the custom library. For example, during design of a crane, user can create instance of this business object to store input requirements such as load capacity, lift height, support points, and outputs parameters such as the number of pulleys, height of pulleys for the crane and external operation name. The configurator will invoke external operation (defined in custom library ) using operation name, inputs and outputs

TcProperty.description:
cfg0OperationInputFamilies is an array of Cfg0AbsFamily which represents the set of Product Configurator Family
cfg0OperationInputFamilies are required to be passed as input argument parameter while invoking custom Metamodel external operation defined in BMIDE. cfg0OperationInputFamilies adds value by providing Product Configurator Families in their custom Metamodel external operation for their any internal calculations. User has to make sure to pass required Product Configurator families to custom Metamodel external operation which is being requested to be invoked.
NULL value are allowed for cfg0OperationInputFamilies. If the custom Metamodel external operation does not require any Product Configurator Family, then NULL value are allowed. Again user has to make sure that custom Metamodel external operation requires any Product Configurator families or not.

cfg0OperationOutputFamilies is an array of Cfg0AbsFamily which represents the set of Product Configurator Family.
cfg0OperationOutputFamilies are required to be passed as output argument parameter while invoking custom Metamodel external operation defined in BMIDE. cfg0OperationOutputFamilies adds value by providing Product Configurator Families in their custom Metamodel external operation so as to send the calculated value (if any) back to Product Configurator which can be used in Product Configurator families value for further Configurator solve operations. User has to make sure to pass required Product Configurator families to custom Metamodel external operation which is being requested to be invoked. NULL value are allowed for cfg0OperationInputs. If the custom Metamodel external operation does not send any Product Configurator Family values back, then NULL value are allowed. Again user has to make sure that custom Metamodel external operation requires any Product Configurator families or not.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsFamily is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSO. It represents a product variant configuration family which provides the variant configuration options to user.The Cfg0AbsFamily helps user to anchor the variant configuration options. For example, to provide different color options for his product say Red, Blue and Green, user can create a configuration family and associate it with the Cfg0ConfContext Item such as Cfg0ProductItem or Cfg0Dictionary. Then, user can define the above Features linked to the family. User can create the Cfg0AbsFamily with different data types such as Text, Integer, Floating Point, Boolean with extra qualification such as free-form values, multi-select values, Unit Of Measure. A family is uniquely identified with its attributes cfg0ObjectId and cfg0FamilyNamespace.

TcProperty.description: Specifies the list of family group objects with which the current family is associated.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsFamilyAvailability is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsAvailability. It associates a product configuration object like Cfg0AbsFamily with a context object like Cfg0AbsModel.The Cfg0AbsFamilyAvailability helps user to make a family available or un-available to say a Cfg0AbsModel. For example, in Car product with models LXI and ZXI, there could be a Family 'AutoGearOptions' available to only ZXI. This constraint can be materialized using Cfg0AbsFamilyAvailability. The target of the Cfg0AbsFamilyAvailability will be the Family 'AutoGearOptions' and the context will be the model ZXI. The availability objects behave as constraints during validation of the product configurations.

Cfg0AbsFamilyGroup is a container of variant configuration families of type Cfg0AbsFamily.The Cfg0AbsFamilyGroup helps user to group the families and present them in auto mode of variant configuration. For example, for a Car product, the Interior Color and Floor Type families can be grouped into say Interior Options Group. In auto mode of variant configuration of the product, user can work on one group at a time and select the relevant grouped options.

TcProperty.description: Specifies list of Cfg0ConfContext objects to which current family group is associated.
Specifies list of family revisions grouped by current group object.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsFamilyGroupThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsFamilyGroup object.

The Cfg0AbsFamilyThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConfiguratorWSOThrd. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsFamily object.A Cfg0AbsFamily object has many attributes which are independent of revisions such as namespace, feature data type and unit of measure etc. They cannot be changed once the object is saved.

The Cfg0AbsFeasibilityRule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRule. It defines a configurator constraint rule to assert the feasibility of a Feature against a combination of Features in a product configuration.The Cfg0AbsFeasibilityRule helps user to express a feasible combination of Features in a product configuration. The Cfg0AbsFeasibilityRule imply a constraint that the applicability of all feasibility rules for the same subject must be satisfied.
The Cfg0AbsFeasibilityRuleThrd is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValidationRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsFeasibilityRule object.

The Cfg0AbsFeature is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsFamily. User can group this type of Features to objects of Cfg0AbsFeatureFamily and Cfg0AbsFeatureSet type. These Features does not support comparison with other features. It supports only equality operators like '=' and '!=' in Variant Configuration. The object of this type cannot have property multi-select and free-form as True.

TcProperty.description: Specifies the list of Cfg0ConfContext Items to which Feature is allocated. It helps in whereUsed use cases for the Feature.
Specifies the Feature Summary revisions which summarize the Feature.
Specifies the Feature Package revisions which have this Feature as its member.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsFeatureFamily is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsFamily. The Cfg0AbsFeatureFamily helps user to group the variant configuration Features which are mutually exclusive. For example Red, Black, White, Taxi, PoliceCar are grouped in a single Dynamic Family to achieve mutually exclusive behavior among them. These are different possible Colors of Product Variant. Unlike other families, here user can define exception for member features with respect to Product Model and/or Effectivity using Exception Rules. Associate Dynamic Family and Features with the Cfg0ConfContext Item such as Cfg0ProductItem or Cfg0Dictionary to view them during variant configuration.

TcProperty.description: cfg0Features is runtime typed referenced array property which represents list of Features grouped by current Dynamic Family object. cfg0Features provides the list of configured revisions of values referred by cfg0FeatureThreads for current Dynamic Family object per current Configurator Perspective.
Specifies the list of Cfg0ConfContext Items to which Dynamic Family is allocated. It helps in whereUsed use cases for the family.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsFeatureFamilyThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsFamilyThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsFeatureFamily object. A Cfg0AbsFeatureFamily object has many attributes which are independent of revisions such as namespace, feature data type etc. They cannot be changed once the object is saved.

The Cfg0AbsFeatureSet is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsFamily. The Cfg0AbsFeatureSet helps user to group the variant configuration Features for authoring the variant expressions. For example Red, Black, White, Taxi, PoliceCar are grouped in a single Dynamic Family to achieve ORed boolean relation during grid authoring. Unlike Dynamic Family, here members does not follow mutually exclusive behavior by virtue of Feature Set membership. Associate Feature set and Features with the Cfg0ConfContext Item such as Cfg0ProductItem or Cfg0Dictionary to view them during authoring of variant expressions.

TcProperty.description: cfg0Features is runtime typed referenced array property which represents list of Features grouped by current Feature Set object. cfg0Features provides the list of configured revisions of values referred by cfg0FeatureThreads for current Feature Set object per current Configurator Perspective.
Specifies the list of Cfg0ConfContext Items to which Feature Set is allocated. It helps in whereUsed use cases for the Feature Set.

TcStandardType.description: The Cfg0AbsFeatureSetThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsFamilyThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsFeatureSet object.
The Cfg0AbsFeatureThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsFamilyThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsFeature object.

The Cfg0AbsFreeFormRule is an abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRule. The Cfg0AbsFreeFormRule helps user to express restriction which is not restricted to Teamcenter expression format. We can represent expression as per industry standard language for constraint solver. The product configuration is evaluated against all such configurator constraints applicable to the product to determine if it is a valid or invalid configuration and update the configuration if necessary to make it a valid one. For example, "assert ( => ( > ( * length width) 100) ( = TruckModel M1))" to represent business constraint where (length * width) > 100 then include TruckModel = M1. "(assert ( ite a (!b) (ite b (!a) a)) )"to represent XOR relation among three independent features a,b.
The Cfg0AbsFreeFormRuleThread is an abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsFreeFormRule object.

The Cfg0AbsIncludeRule is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRule. It defines a configurator constraint rule for dependency of Features in a product configuration.The Cfg0AbsIncludeRule helps user to express a positive validity restriction to a combination of Features in a product configuration. For example, user creates a restriction of selecting Engine Capacity as 1.2 liter only, whenever Car model is Economy and the Fuel Type is Petrol. For given conditions, if the Engine Capacity is other than 1.2 liter, then, it would be an invalid product configuration and a violation with the message and severity of the violated rule is returned to user. If the product configuration has Car model as Economy and the Fuel Type as Petrol, then, the constraint rule will force to include the Engine Capacity as 1.2 liter in the configuration. The product configuration is evaluated against all such configurator constraints applicable to the product to determine if it is a valid or invalid configuration and update the configuration if necessary to make it a valid one.
The Cfg0AbsIncludeRuleThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsIncludeRule object.
The Cfg0AbsLiteralFamilyThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionFamilyThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsLiteralValueFamily object.

The Cfg0AbsLiteralOptionValue is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionValue. It represents the non-compound and non-model variant configuration options.The Cfg0AbsLiteralOptionValue helps user to represent the literal variant configuration options for his product. For example, to provide options for Internal Colors such as Grey, Silver and Maroon, user can create a string family say Internal Colors and associates it with the Cfg0ConfContext Item such as Cfg0ProductItem or Cfg0Dictionary. Then, user can define the above Features as concrete instantiable type of Cfg0AbsLiteralOptionValue linked to the family. The Cfg0AbsLiteralOptionValue is typically a part of an enumerated Feature list and it takes part in product configuration definition as a literal expression. For example, Internal Colors=Grey.

The Cfg0AbsLiteralValueFamily is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionFamily. It provides the non-compound and non-model variant configuration options to user.The Cfg0AbsLiteralValueFamily helps user to define the literal variant configuration options for his product.
The Cfg0AbsLiteralValueThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsOptionValueThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsLiteralOptionValue object.

The Cfg0AbsMatrixRule is abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRule. It defines a configurator constraint for dependency of features for a base variant in a product configuration. The Cfg0AbsMatrixRule helps user to author set constraints for a base variant as one object which share a common purpose. It enables authoring and managing complete feature planning constraints for a base variant as single workspace object. For example, user creates a restriction of selecting Engine Capacity as 1.2 liter only, Color is Red, Black and White and White is default, and may more such configuration options whenever base variant of Car model be Economy with the Fuel Type as Petrol. For given conditions, if the Engine Capacity is other than 1.2 liter, then, it would be an invalid product configuration and a violation with the message and severity of the violated rule is returned to user. If the product configuration has Car model as Economy and the Fuel Type as Petrol, then, the constraint rule will force to include the Engine Capacity as 1.2-liter, Color either of Red, Black and White where White is default color which user can override in the configuration. The product configuration is evaluated against all such configurator constraints applicable to the product to determine if it is a valid or invalid configuration and update the configuration if necessary to make it a valid one.
The Cfg0AbsMatrixRuleThread is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsConstraintRuleThread. It is common to all revisions of a Cfg0AbsMatrixRule object.

The Cfg0AbsModel is the abstract subtype of Cfg0AbsValue. It represents product variant configuration model options.The Cfg0AbsModel values can be used to link a business strategy for a product to its technology configuration options. For example, to provide different model options for his product say Car as Economy and Luxury, User can create a configuration model family and attach it with the Cfg0ProductItem. Then, user can define the above model Features linked to the family. The model values are always specific to a product and hence, they can be attached to a single Cfg0ProductItem using the attribute cfg0OwningProductItem. The allocations and family groups are not supported for a Cfg0AbsModel. The Cfg0AbsModel stores direct references of its family object id and the owning Cfg0ProductItem Item. Cfg0AbsModel is the abstract superclass for compound as well as elemental product models.

TcProperty.description: Specifies the revision of the Cfg0AbsModelFamily to which current model is attached to.
